title: hive-admit check: request body
description: Runs the admission checks of spec/pool.md against an admission's Imperative revision, the item as it stands and the evidence the caller supplies, and records the result with its receipt. It may be run again: every launch path runs it, and a later check with new evidence may admit what an earlier one held. The response status follows the result: ok for admitted, refused for refused, held for held.

placement.description: requested: check the place the item requests. resolved: check the place the caller's policy resolved, named with the policy receipt.

source_branch.description: What the caller established about the source branch. Required for a check to admit a Void placement; absent, a Void placement is held for an unpushed branch.

rules_digest.description: The resolved-rule digest the caller resolved for this dispatch, recorded with the check.
